confidence_notes: I ran five web searches: one for the RBA rate and four for prices. They returned aggregated or crowd-sourced figures, not menus, and I did not open or verify any individual pages. Saranda-specific cappuccino (about EUR 1.9), beer (about 200-400 ALL) and cocktail/wine ranges (600-1,200 ALL and 300-600 ALL) came from travel-cost guides. Meal prices leaned on Numbeo Tirana figures (inexpensive meal about 800 ALL; mid-range three-course meal for two about 4,500 ALL). I converted from ALL at roughly 84 ALL per USD, assuming about 96-98 ALL per EUR. July peak-season and promenade pricing is uncertain and could be higher. I did not search for accommodation. Those four anchors are holistic estimates from general knowledge of Saranda's seasonal tourism market, not from live listings, and they are the least certain. Cocktail and wine were set from the source ranges and checked against the beer price.
comparable_city_reasoning: Saranda is a seasonal Albanian Riviera resort town. Food and drink are based on Saranda-specific and Albania-wide price guides and Numbeo Tirana and Berat data, adjusted upward for July tourist-season pricing. Accommodation is judged against nearby Ionian and Adriatic coastal resort towns (e.g. Ksamil, Himara, Corfu's cheaper areas).
